title: Odd BLR AND-test rejection gap
statement: For each natural number $n$, the odd BLR AND-test rejection gap is the minimum of the set of rejection probabilities attained by non-dictator Boolean functions on sign vectors of length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: The set of rejection values is nonempty
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the rejection values or provide the nonemptiness result's mathematical content.
